Step.SQLStatement: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DictionaryInconsistency AS SELECT db.DB_ElementType, db.DB_ElementName, db.DB_Element_ID, db.DB_InconsistencyType FROM (SELECT -- Check for physical Tables that do not exist in DataBase 'TA' AS DB_ElementType, t.TableName AS DB_ElementName, t.AD_Table_ID AS DB_Element_ID, 'MT' as DB_InconsistencyType FROM AD_Table t WHERE t.IsActive = 'Y' AND t.IsView = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_tables pt WHERE LOWER(pt.TableName) = LOWER(t.TableName) AND pt.SchemaName = 'adempiere' ) UNION ALL -- Check for physical columns that exist but may have different data TYPES SELECT 'CO' AS DB_ElementType, c.ColumnName AS DB_ElementName, c.AD_Column_ID AS DB_Element_ID, CASE WHEN pc.data_type IS NULL THEN 'NE' WHEN ( (c.AD_Reference_ID IN (11, 12, 13, 18,19,22,29, 30) AND pc.data_type NOT IN ('numeric', 'decimal', 'integer', 'bigint')) OR (c.AD_Reference_ID IN (10,17, 20,14,17, 34, 36, 38,39,40,42,53670) AND pc.data_type NOT IN ('character varying', 'text', 'varchar', 'character')) OR (c.AD_Reference_ID IN (15,16,24) AND pc.data_type NOT IN ('date', 'timestamp', 'timestamptz', 'timestamp without time zone', 'timestamp with time zone')) OR (c.AD_Reference_ID = 23 AND pc.data_type NOT IN ('bytea')) OR (c.AD_Reference_ID = 25 AND (c.ColumnName LIKE '%_Acct' OR c.ColumnName LIKE '%_ID') AND pc.data_type NOT IN ('numeric', 'decimal', 'integer', 'bigint')) OR (c.AD_Reference_ID = 25 AND c.ColumnName NOT LIKE '%_Acct' AND c.ColumnName NOT LIKE '%_ID' AND pc.data_type NOT IN ('character varying', 'text', 'varchar', 'character')) OR (c.AD_Reference_ID = 28 AND c.ColumnName LIKE '%_ID' AND pc.data_type NOT IN ('numeric', 'decimal', 'integer', 'bigint')) OR (c.AD_Reference_ID = 28 AND c.ColumnName NOT LIKE '%_ID' AND pc.data_type NOT IN ('character varying', 'text', 'varchar', 'character')) ) THEN 'TD' WHEN ( (c.DefaultValue NOT LIKE '@SQL%' AND c.DefaultValue NOT LIKE '@%@' AND '-1' NOT LIKE TRIM(C.DefaultValue) AND pc.Column_Default NOT LIKE '%'||c.DefaultValue||'%') OR (C.DefaultValue = TRIM('-1') AND pc.Column_Default NOT LIKE '%NULL%') ) THEN 'DD' ELSE 'OK' END as DB_InconsistencyType FROM AD_Table t JOIN AD_Column c ON t.AD_Table_ID = c.AD_Table_ID LEFT JOIN information_schema.columns pc ON LOWER(pc.Table_Name) = LOWER(t.TableName) AND LOWER(pc.Column_Name) = LOWER(c.ColumnName) AND pc.Table_Schema = 'adempiere' WHERE t.IsActive = 'Y' AND t.IsView = 'N' AND c.IsActive = 'Y' AND (c.ColumnSQL IS NULL OR c.ColumnSQL = '') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_tables pt WHERE LOWER(pt.TableName) = LOWER(t.TableName) AND pt.SchemaName = 'adempiere' ) AND c.ColumnName NOT IN ('AD_Language', 'EntityType') AND LOWER(t.TableName) NOT IN('T_selection_browse', 't_selection', 't_selection2', 't_sp036_CopyReference', 't_alter_column', 't_sp036_copyreference') ORDER BY DB_InconsistencyType, DB_ElementType, DB_Element_ID ) AS db WHERE db.DB_InconsistencyType <> 'OK';
